name: implement arc-style grid transformation from examples
definition: derive and code a pure function mapping an input 2d integer grid to an output 2d grid that reproduces the supplied input/output examples.
failure_mode: wrong transformation logic or wrong function name yields mismatched outputs

name: install a specific Triton version and execute kernels in CPU interpreter mode
definition: Set up the required triton version and environment so jit kernels run on CPU via the interpreter path.
failure_mode: Kernels fail to compile or run on CPU, or wrong triton version breaks them
